liveIntro: Connect local NAS, Baidu Netdisk and Google Drive. Browse files and use selected documents with AI.
googleStep1: Create a Google Cloud project and enable Google Drive API.
googleStep2: Configure Google Auth Platform branding and audience; add your Google account as a test user.
googleStep3: Create an OAuth client of type Desktop app. Copy Client ID and Client Secret below, then authorize.
baiduStep1: Open your existing app in the Baidu Netdisk developer console.
baiduStep2: Copy its App Key and Secret Key below; verify that the app has the required Netdisk API permissions.
baiduStep3: Start authorization, open the official Baidu page and enter the device code shown here.
googleTesting: Testing-mode authorization may expire after 7 days. Authorize on the computer running this Ryn node; the local callback is automatic.

onedriveStep1: Open Microsoft Entra → App registrations → New registration. Choose accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts.
onedriveStep2: Under Authentication → Advanced settings, enable Allow public client flows. Add Microsoft Graph delegated Files.Read permission; add Files.ReadWrite if you need uploads. Device-code login needs no client secret or redirect URI.
onedriveStep3: Copy the Application (client) ID from Overview into Ryn. Start authorization, enter the displayed code on Microsoft’s page, and sign in to the OneDrive account you want to connect.
onedriveNotes: Supports personal and work/school OneDrive on Microsoft’s global service. Organization policies may require admin approval. Only your own drive is connected; shared shortcuts and SharePoint libraries are not included. Empty-file uploads are not supported in this version.
